scope: Proposition 7 of the manuscript “Integer multiplication below n log n” (preprints/Integer-multiplication-below-n-log-n-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 109 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 834f644c3ce67932), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The bit network has Wb wires, uses only pointwise XOR gates, and sends its input vector to the permutation ρ of that vector. Its rational matrices are common to all incidences of a gate and obey Msink(ρ(w)) − Msource(w) = Im for every input role w. The sum of the rational ranks of all edge differences is sb = X e rankQ(Mhead(e) − Mtail(e)) (8) = Wbm − N + 2Lb = 177176569088785861287000000 < Wbm. (9)
